ruleDefinitions.name: SMB Create Remote File Admin Share
ruleDefinitions.description: Look for non-system accounts SMB accessing a file with write (0x2) access mask via administrative share (i.e C$). Note: Unmapped fields: ShareName, AccessMask

sequences.query: (event_id = 5145 AND ShareName = RGX("C\\$$") AND AccessMask = "0x2") AND  NOT (user = RGX("\\$$"))
